resolution: Editor still OOM'd at ~1.4GB even after defaulting the ISO pane's floraVisible off, because WorldStatics is mounted in MULTIPLE places (IsoPreview.tsx, Embodied.tsx, GameWorld3D/HmscGameplayRig) that pass no showFlora and so defaulted to true — each rebuilding the full grass/palm field. Root cause confirmed: the flora field materialises up to MAX_INSTANCES=1,048,576 blades in JS and ships them as ONE Scene3D.Instances command; that 1M-row array's JSON.stringify is hundreds of MB and OOMs the heap DURING serialization (which is why the [flush-bytes] meter never logged and the burial/propgone probes showed everything rendering geometry yet the window never opened). Fix: flipped the WorldStatics showFlora default from true to false in GameWorld3D.tsx (clean file, not the other session's grassPopulation.ts) so every ungated mount skips the build; IsoAuthor's explicit 'Fl' toggle still opts in. Also confirmed via the burial probe that props are NOT buried (0 buried / 41 on-or-above) — that hypothesis is dead; once the editor opens we learn if props draw or it's a Scene3D issue. Left uncommitted pending the user's confirmation it opens + their nod on the flora-off tradeoff. Durable fix = flora refactor's shader preview.
